soprano-white.$description: Soprano White — Page canvas, header and footer surfaces, image-overlay text, bordered purchase controls

studio-mist.$description: Studio Mist — Product-tile surfaces, category controls, search field, and pale action surfaces

warm-porcelain.$description: Warm Porcelain — Quiet secondary navigation and transitional surface bands

bass-black.$description: Bass Black — Primary text, navigation, icons, hairline borders, dark purchase fills, and inverse badges

countertenor-gray.$description: Countertenor Gray — Announcement-strip field, subdued controls, and inactive control treatment

steel-gray.$description: Steel Gray — Fine separators and low-emphasis form borders

charcoal-helper.$description: Charcoal Helper — Footer links, supporting links, and subdued utility text

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Search and utility icon strokes, input text, and high-contrast micro-details

quiet-placeholder.$description: Quiet Placeholder — Search placeholder and inactive input copy

chord-blue.$description: Chord Blue — Inline learning links — a single electric-blue interruption in an otherwise monochrome retail interface

bose-headline.$description: Condensed display voice for section titles and campaign headlines. The 900 weight at 60px and 96px is compressed vertically rather than made airy, making the headline read like a bold audio-equipment mark; the 400 weight supplies quieter 32px service headings.

bose-text.$description: Interface, product metadata, navigation, links, and campaign support copy. Regular 15px uppercase navigation stays restrained; 500-weight 16px labels and 24px campaign support text provide the controlled step-up beneath the headline.
